summary.zh-CN: 修复更新后页面、Agent、服务重启和命令行仍可能使用不同 runtime 版本的问题。
summary.en-US: Keeps the UI, agents, service restarts, and CLI on the same runtime after an update.

title.zh-CN: 更新后的命令保持一致

body.zh-CN: 页面重连后，Agent、服务重启和新开的 nextclaw 命令都会使用当前 runtime，不再回到旧版 app。
body.en-US: After the page reconnects, agents, service restarts, and newly opened nextclaw commands use the current runtime instead of returning to the previous app.

body.zh-CN: 继续从页面下载并应用更新即可，不需要在重连后再手动安装一次全局命令。
body.en-US: Download and apply the update from the page as before; no second global installation is required after reconnecting.

title.zh-CN: 稳定 launcher 合同不变

body.zh-CN: 稳定 launcher 仍负责更新选择、回滚和兼容性保护；全局 npm 包可以低于当前 runtime。
body.en-US: The stable launcher still selects updates, handles rollback, and protects compatibility; the global npm package may be older than the current runtime.
